note: Wording dispute on E: a crawler on a plain cron schedule cannot run after the job. It works only as an event (job-completion) trigger (about-triggers: a trigger fires on a schedule or a combination of events). D (scheduled Glue ETL job, monitor-data-warehouse-schedule) and E are the only viable pair.
AWS Batch runs containerized jobs and queues them, provisioning compute for each (what-is-batch). Lambda cannot run a 45-minute job (15-minute cap).

Glue is serverless Spark with no infrastructure to manage (what-is-glue), and its jobs can run on a time-based schedule. A 40-minute Lambda conversion exceeds the 15-minute cap; the EMR option needs a cluster.
